s: to make dull and/or guttural sounds
rallen.et: From Low German rallen (“to talk, chatter”), from Middle Low German rallen, likely of onomatopoeic origin. Compare Danish ralle, which has the same sense as the Modern German.

Ralf.et: Borrowed from English Ralph in the nineteenth century.
